triage_candidates.statement: FastF1 pos_data X/Y are in decimetres (not metres) — this non-obvious unit convention should be documented in the architecture docs/contract.py for the fastf1_api struct boundary. Currently only documented in strawman_candidate.py.

GP name divergence: FastF1 uses 'Belgian Grand Prix' while DB stores 'Belgium'. The gp_name_in_db runner parameter is a workaround. Other GPs likely have similar mismatches. Data layer should document canonical name mapping or add a lookup table.
fastf1.Cache.offline_mode() is only available in FastF1 >= 3.0. On older builds the AttributeError is silently swallowed (best-effort). A version check raising explicitly would be safer.
